record.paper_title: Infinity in string cosmology: A review through open problems
record.original_question: For Robertson-Walker branes with a perfect fluid in the bulk or brane description, can one find a regular bulk solution that both localizes gravity on the brane and satisfies the null energy condition in the bulk, despite the obstruction already known for single-fluid models?

evidence.quote:
4.2 RW branes with perfect ﬂuid
However, the issue of ﬁnding a regular bulk solution is further complicated by the existence of extra constraints, namely, how to localize gravity on the brane and at the same time meet the requirements of the null energy condition in the bulk. The content of the paper [79] shows that this is not possible for single ﬂuids, a result that points to our next problem.

artifact.status_search_result: For a single linear perfect fluid (p = wρ) in the bulk, the simultaneous requirements of bulk regularity, gravity localization, and the null energy condition are known to be incompatible (no-go result). Subsequent work extending the analysis to nonlinear bulk fluids with equation of state p = γρ^λ (λ > 1, γ < 0) constructs explicit regular braneworld solutions that satisfy the NEC and localize gravity, but the four-dimensional Planck mass diverges in the perfect-fluid limit λ → 1. Thus the obstruction remains for genuine perfect fluids, while it is evaded by nonlinear generalizations; no perfect-fluid solution meeting all three conditions is known.

status_evidence.title: Regular braneworlds with nonlinear bulk-fluids
status_evidence.snippet: For γ negative and λ > 1, the null energy condition is satisfied... the integral for the induced 4d effective Planck mass is finite, leading to localized gravity on the brane for any value of the exponent λ > 1. However, in the perfect fluid limit λ → 1, the 4d Planck mass diverges.
status_evidence.claim: The obstruction persists for the perfect-fluid case but is overcome by nonlinear bulk fluids.

status_evidence.title: Regular braneworlds with bulk fluids (arXiv:2110.15079)
status_evidence.snippet: Regular five-dimensional brane-world with localized gravity on a flat 3-brane with bulk matter parameterized by a non-linear fluid p = γρ^λ.
status_evidence.claim: Resolution requires nonlinear (non perfect-fluid) bulk matter.
